Who Receives Technical Violations?

Who receives technical violations?

  1. What proportion of youth on probation supervision receive a technical violation during a probation term? How does this vary across race/ethnicity, sex, and risk level?

  2. Descriptive overview of the population of youth who receive a technical violation during the study period (when technical violation was the primary offense) by race/ethnicity, age category, sex, and risk level

  3. What proportion of violations filed by a PO are rejected by supervisor or prosecutor?

3. Supervisor/Prosecutor Rejections (changed to dismissals)

Business Rule: According to Dallas County, all of the technical violation records without a referral number indicate that a PO filed the violation, but that it was rejected by a supervisor.

NOTE/To Discuss: Only about 2% of all violations fit this criteria – not sure if it warrants analysis (especially anything disaggregated). For now, I am exploring violations with dispositions of “DISMISSED OR WITHDRAWN BY DEPARTMENT” – which I believe indicates a sanction to the 30 day residential program (where if a kid is successful, the violation is dismissed). If we want to use this analysis, we should (1) confirm this interpretation with Dallas and (2) ask whether this disposition is only for youth who are successful in the program and if so, if there is a way to flag youth who are not successful.

Is this worth further analysis/exploration?
